payload.summary: Digital Retina contains executable local multimodal architecture and raw E2E result lineage. Historical strict text coverage progressed from 35.3% Tier-3 hard-set to 44.80% p8 and 87.81% p12 on the same 279 phrases while CLIP-lenient coverage remained 94.62%, separating representation presence from semantic surfacing. A later 32-image/681-phrase fresh set scored 72.25% strict and 92.51% lenient, showing partial generalization with a material strict-distribution gap. Hard-set raw metadata names gemini-2.0-flash while prose names Llama-4 Scout, so baseline-model attribution remains unresolved. Downstream visual elaboration historically amplified wrong detector labels; current VisualPercept needs provenance/confidence/abstention-preserving transforms.
